newsitem.title: USA: Life Medical Science ends CARIEL tests.
newsitem.headline: Life Medical Science ends CARIEL tests.

text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said Tuesday it ended its venous stasis ulcer clinical trial of CARIEL topical wounded healing gel in Europe.
It said based on its of the trial results to date, the project, does not warrant further funding.
The trial was aimed at establishing CARIEL as the first product ever to heal venous stasis ulcers without compression therapy, the traditional standard of treatment.
It said it will apply the funds to other development programs, including the application of CARIEL in possible future clinical trials for diabetic ulcers and burns.
